company.name: CircleBack
company.shortDescription: A technology company focused on solving a major productivity problem: keeping contact data accurate.
company.description: Founded outside of Washington DC, CircleBack, Inc. is a technology company dedicated to solving a major productivity problem: keeping contact data accurate. Using a patented data engine, CircleBack lets you know when connections change jobs, companies, email addresses, and work numbers, delivering these updates directly to mobile address books and CRMs. This makes it easier than ever for both professionals and businesses to keep connections alive and get stuff done faster and with more accuracy.

productsAndServices.description: A service that consolidates contacts from multiple networks into a single, synchronized address book accessible across devices.
